name: Endeavour (STS-127)
about: Endeavour (STS-127) (2009-038A), a crewed vehicle (STS), launched 2009 Jul 15. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2009 Jul 18), held fixed
docked to A06140; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
